nodes.description: Public token symbol string 'RCO' set in the GGMToken constructor.
Public token name string 'Rocco' set in the GGMToken constructor.
Public decimals value (18) for the token.
Total token supply (100000000) assigned to the deployer-chosen holder address.
Mapping(address => uint) holding every account token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner => spender => allowance; mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Owned.owner address, the privileged account gating onlyOwner functions.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
msg.sender, the external caller identity used for balances, allowances, ownership and access control checks.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure function performing overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure function performing underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure function performing overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure function performing division with zero check.
Owned.transferOwnership(address) restricted by onlyOwner; stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() letting the staged newOwner claim ownership and emit OwnershipTransferred.
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus the burn address balance.
balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moving tokens and decrementing the caller allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view returning the remaining allowance.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets the allowance then invokes the spender's receiveApproval callback.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer() on an arbitrary token address to move tokens to owner.
GGMToken constructor, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and initializes metadata.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance state write, enabling attacker-controlled reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, unvalidated token address.
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control guard implemented in the onlyOwner modifier.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, staged as the pending owner.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(), destination of the token balance credit.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(), amount debited/credited.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(), the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(), the approved amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(), the debited account.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(), the credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(), amount moved and deducted from allowance.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance(), the allowance owner looked up.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance(), the spender looked up.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall(), also the external contract invoked as a callback target.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall(), the approved amount.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall(), forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token(), an unvalidated arbitrary contract address.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token(), the rescue amount.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf(), the queried account.
Local variable c in safeAdd holding the checked sum.
Local variable c in safeSub holding the checked difference.
Local variable c in safeMul holding the checked product.
Local variable c in safeDiv holding the checked quotient.

edges.reason: transfer() reads msg.sender to debit balances[msg.sender].
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom() reads msg.sender to decrement the caller allowance.
approveAndCall() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, so caller identity controls ownership takeover.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender against owner.
The onlyOwner require compares the untrusted msg.sender with owner.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, fixing the initial privileged account.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable through the onlyOwner modifier.
The onlyOwner check reads the stored owner address as the comparison target.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the privileged owner address as the rescue destination.
acceptOwnership compares and then clears the newOwner staging variable.
acceptOwnership writes the owner state variable, completing the ownership handover.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable, staging a privileged role change.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf() returns a value read from the balances mapping.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] to net out burned tokens.
approve() writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply minus the zero-address balance.
The constructor writes the _totalSupply state variable.
The constructor credits the full supply into the balances mapping.
The constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
The constructor assigns the name state variable.
The constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
safeAdd assigns the checked sum into local c.
safeSub assigns the checked difference into local c.
safeMul assigns the checked product into local c.
safeDiv assigns the checked quotient into local c.
transferOwnership binds the _newOwner parameter that will become privileged.
transfer uses the 'to' parameter as the credit destination.
transfer uses the 'tokens' parameter as the moved amount.
The 'to' parameter indexes the balances mapping credit in transfer().
The 'tokens' parameter is added to and subtracted from balances entries.
approve uses the 'spender' parameter as the allowance key.
approve uses the 'tokens' parameter as the approved value.
The 'spender' parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve().
The 'tokens' parameter is stored into the allowed mapping in approve().
transferFrom uses the 'from' parameter as the debited account.
transferFrom uses the 'to' parameter as the credited account.
transferFrom uses the 'tokens' parameter as the moved amount.
The 'from' parameter indexes the balances mapping debit in transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter indexes the balances mapping credit in transferFrom().
The 'tokens' parameter modifies balances entries in transferFrom().
The 'tokens' parameter is subtracted from the allowed mapping in transferFrom().
allowance uses the 'tokenOwner' parameter as the outer mapping key.
allowance uses the 'spender' parameter as the inner mapping key.
approveAndCall uses the 'spender' parameter both as allowance key and callback target.
approveAndCall uses the 'tokens' parameter as the approved value.
approveAndCall forwards the attacker-supplied 'data' parameter to the external callee.
The 'spender' parameter indexes the allowed mapping write in approveAndCall().
The 'tokens' parameter is stored into the allowed mapping in approveAndCall().
The caller-controlled 'spender' address determines the contract invoked inside the receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the 'tokenAddress' parameter as the callee contract.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the 'tokens' parameter as the rescue amount.
The arbitrary 'tokenAddress' parameter is cast to ERC20Interface and called, allowing a malicious callee.
balanceOf uses the 'tokenOwner' parameter to index the balances mapping.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into the spender after writing the allowance, so a malicious spender can re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external callback into an arbitrary token contract under the owner's authority.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner require check.
transferAnyERC20Token execution is gated by the onlyOwner require check.
transfer delegates balance subtraction to safeSub to guard against underflow.
transfer delegates balance addition to safeAdd to guard against overflow.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance subtraction to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates balance addition to safeAdd.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to write the newOwner staging state variable inside transferOwnership and carries no independent behavior.
Parameter 'to' of transfer is a pure indexing input of the balances credit and should be folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer is a transient amount consumed by safeSub/safeAdd and should be folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter 'spender' of approve is only an allowance lookup key and should be folded into the approve function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve is only the allowance value written and should be folded into the approve function node.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom is a transient balances lookup key and should be folded into the transferFrom function node.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom is a transient balances lookup key and should be folded into the transferFrom function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom is a transient amount used by safeSub/safeAdd and should be folded into the transferFrom function node.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance is a read-only mapping key and should be folded into the allowance function node.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance is a read-only mapping key and should be folded into the allowance function node.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall is both allowance key and callback target and should be folded into the approveAndCall function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall is only the allowance value and should be folded into the approveAndCall function node.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall is opaque calldata forwarded to the external receiver and should be folded into the approveAndCall function node.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token is the arbitrary callee address and should be folded into the transferAnyERC20Token function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token is the rescue amount and should be folded into the transferAnyERC20Token function node.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf is a read-only mapping key and should be folded into the balanceOf function node.
Local variable c in safeAdd is a single-use return holder and should be folded into the safeAdd function node.
Local variable c in safeSub is a single-use return holder and should be folded into the safeSub function node.
Local variable c in safeMul is a single-use return holder and should be folded into the safeMul function node.
Local variable c in safeDiv is a single-use return holder and should be folded into the safeDiv function node.
